quest_pool.title: Recover Lost Telemetry
quest_pool.objective: Retrieve 4 corrupted navigation telemetry fragments drifting near the ship.
quest_pool.description: A solar flare scrambled our telemetry. I need those fragments recovered before the next jump window closes.

quest_pool.title: Scan the Phantom Signal
quest_pool.objective: Gather 1 clean sample of the anomalous phantom signal detected near the Neon Underground.
quest_pool.description: There's a repeating signal flickering in and out of the comms band. It’s… not supposed to exist. Get me a clean capture.

quest_pool.title: Reroute Power Flow
quest_pool.objective: Stabilize 3 failing power nodes located in the Forge.
quest_pool.description: The navigation core is starving for power again. Head to the Forge and stabilize the failing nodes.

quest_pool.title: Clear the Flight Path
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 debris shards blocking the upcoming jump trajectory.
quest_pool.description: We can't enter FTL with debris blocking the jump corridor. Clear the shards before we burn time.

quest_pool.title: Resolve the Traffic Alert
quest_pool.objective: Collect 3 transponder IDs from vessels clogging the approach lane to the Mos Eisley Cantina.
quest_pool.description: Someone jammed the approach lanes with unregistered vessels. Get their transponders before we lose traffic control entirely.

quest_pool.title: Trace the Nightmare Glitch
quest_pool.objective: Collect 2 glitch signatures from the Neural Jack Lounge’s malfunctioning dream modules.
quest_pool.description: Someone fed bad code into the dreamscape simulations. Collect the glitch signatures before they spread.

quest_pool.title: Fresh Seedpod Harvest
quest_pool.objective: Gather 6 healthy seedpods for the new biodome sprouting chamber.
quest_pool.description: The sprouting chamber is starving for new life! We need fresh seedpods before the next cycle.

quest_pool.title: Soil Enrichment Run
quest_pool.objective: Collect 10 enriched soil samples from the Forge's heat-treated bays.
quest_pool.description: We need hot-forged soil to balance the nitrogen mix. Grab samples from the Forge bays — but don’t burn your fingers!

quest_pool.title: Bioluminescent Moss Recovery
quest_pool.objective: Collect 4 samples of bioluminescent moss from the Neon Underground.
quest_pool.description: The moss down there glows like a dream. We need it for our light-regulation cycle in Dome Three!

quest_pool.title: Condensate Collection
quest_pool.objective: Gather 5 condensate canisters from the Neural Jack Lounge coolant vents.
quest_pool.description: Their coolant cycles make PERFECT purified water. Grab me some before the vents thaw.

quest_pool.title: Food Waste Reclamation
quest_pool.objective: Collect 3 bins of compostable material from Mos Eisley Cantina.
quest_pool.description: Their kitchen scraps are PERFECT for our compost drums. Grab the bins before they toss them into the incinerator!

quest_pool.title: Oxygen Cycle Calibration
quest_pool.objective: Gather 2 oxygen calibration logs from the Bridge’s life-support console.
quest_pool.description: We can’t grow healthy plants without perfect oxygen cycling. The Bridge console keeps the best logs!

quest_pool.title: Trace the Neon Glitch
quest_pool.objective: Collect 3 glitch shards from corrupted neural simulations.
quest_pool.description: Something nasty crawled into my dream servers. Grab me three glitch shards before it spreads to the premium suites.

quest_pool.title: Recover the Data Whisper
quest_pool.objective: Collect 1 encrypted data whisper from the Neon Underground.
quest_pool.description: Someone dropped an encrypted whisper in the alleys. Bring it to me, babe — I like knowing things I shouldn’t.

quest_pool.title: Salvage Memory Fragments
quest_pool.objective: Gather 4 memory fragments from the Forge’s derelict processors.
quest_pool.description: Old processors keep breaking down, leaving memory bits everywhere. Go on — pick up the pieces. Story of my life.

quest_pool.title: Snag the Rogue Signal
quest_pool.objective: Collect 2 rogue signal echoes from the Bridge’s deep-scan relay.
quest_pool.description: A signal’s bouncing around the void and playing hard to get. Snag me a couple echoes, and I’ll make it worth your time.

quest_pool.title: The Missing Bar Tab
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 abandoned drink chips from Mos Eisley Cantina.
quest_pool.description: Some idiots ran up a tab and vanished. Grab their leftover chips, will ya? I promise I’ll give you a… personal discount.

quest_pool.title: Dream Seed Exchange
quest_pool.objective: Gather 3 dream seeds from the Terraforming Station’s neural flora.
quest_pool.description: The plant nerds grew psychic flowers again. Bring me their dream seeds — they make the wildest simulations.

quest_pool.title: Utinni! Scrap Hunt
quest_pool.objective: Collect 6 scrap metal pieces from the Forge
quest_pool.description: *Merchant hops excitedly, pointing at the Forge* Eee-choo! Utinni! *waves tiny hands frantically*

quest_pool.title: Power Cell Salvage
quest_pool.objective: Recover 3 discarded power cells from the Bridge
quest_pool.description: *Merchant rummages in cart, holds up a dead power cell* Hoo-hoo! Eee-tee-nee! *taps it sadly*

quest_pool.title: Droid Graveyard Salvage
quest_pool.objective: Salvage 4 droid components from broken units
quest_pool.description: *Merchant pulls out a droid arm, waves it around* Utinni! Utinni! *points toward the underground*

quest_pool.title: The Glowing Junk
quest_pool.objective: Find 2 pieces of mysteriously glowing salvage
quest_pool.description: *Merchant's eyes glow brighter, whispers reverently* Oooh-tee-dee... *makes explosion gesture* ...Utinni!

quest_pool.title: Wiring Needed!
quest_pool.objective: Gather 8 lengths of salvageable wiring
quest_pool.description: *Merchant holds up tangled wires, shakes head* Eee-choo wa maa! *gestures at empty cart section*

quest_pool.title: Cantina Treasures
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 pieces of junk from under the cantina tables
quest_pool.description: *Merchant peeks under imaginary table, hops excitedly* Hoo-hoo! Eee-tee-nee! *rubs hands together*

quest_pool.title: Broken Tech Recovery
quest_pool.objective: Retrieve 3 broken tech devices from the Terraforming Station
quest_pool.description: *Merchant mimics something breaking, looks sad* Ooo-tini... *then perks up, points excitedly*

quest_pool.title: Shiny Bits Wanted
quest_pool.objective: Find 10 shiny metal bits scattered around
quest_pool.description: *Merchant holds up something sparkly, eyes practically glowing* UTINNI! *bounces up and down*

quest_pool.title: Pickpocket Sweep
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 stolen ID tags from the Neon Underground's busiest alleys.
quest_pool.description: Somebody's cutting into my territory. Grab the ID tags they dropped before the security drones sweep through.

quest_pool.title: Bootleg Hologram Run
quest_pool.objective: Retrieve 3 illegal hologram projectors from the Underground’s back market tunnels.
quest_pool.description: My supplier ghosted me. Again. Go snag the projectors before the knockoff cartel gets to them.

quest_pool.title: Shady Deal Intercept
quest_pool.objective: Collect 4 encrypted data chips being traded under the neon catwalk.
quest_pool.description: Some wannabe hustlers are swapping intel in my lane. Intercept the chips and bring them to me—no questions asked.

quest_pool.title: Underground Delivery Drop
quest_pool.objective: Pick up 2 mystery packages hidden in graffiti-marked lockers.
quest_pool.description: Two drop lockers under the neon rails. Don’t peek inside. Seriously. Don’t.

quest_pool.title: Stolen Tech Retrieval
quest_pool.objective: Recover 3 pieces of stolen scav-tech Aiko claims are 'totally hers.'
quest_pool.description: Some punk lifted my scav-tech stash. I want it back before they figure out how valuable it is.

quest_pool.title: Neon Shard Heist
quest_pool.objective: Gather 6 glowing neon shards that fell from a broken billboard panel.
quest_pool.description: A billboard fried itself and rained neon shards everywhere. Those things sell for a fortune in the crafts market.

quest_pool.title: First Steps in the Dark
quest_pool.objective: Successfully hack 3 systems to prove your skills.
quest_pool.description: So you think you can run with the real netrunners? Prove it. Crack three systems — anything will do. Show me you're not just a script kiddie.

quest_pool.title: Raid the Data Nexus
quest_pool.objective: Hack 5 systems in the Data Nexus.
quest_pool.description: The Data Nexus is where the real action is. Corporate secrets, military intel, juicy paydata. Hit five of their systems and bring me something interesting.

quest_pool.title: Ghost in the Machine
quest_pool.objective: Successfully hack 2 Ghost Servers without dying.
quest_pool.description: There's a server that doesn't exist. Off every grid, behind lethal ICE. Crack two of them and survive? I'll make you a legend.

quest_pool.title: Syndicate Secrets
quest_pool.objective: Hack into 3 Syndicate systems in the Neon Underground.
quest_pool.description: The Syndicate thinks their vault is untouchable. Prove them wrong. Three breaches, and we split whatever intel you pull.

quest_pool.title: Navigation Override
quest_pool.objective: Hack 4 ship navigation systems to gather intel.
quest_pool.description: I need access to flight paths and cargo manifests. Breach four ship systems and download their nav logs. Don't ask why.

quest_pool.title: Factory Override
quest_pool.objective: Hack 3 factory control systems in the Forge.
quest_pool.description: *Merchant holds up broken droid, points at Forge* Eee-choo! *mimics hacking motion* Utinni utinni! *taps cart*

quest_pool.title: ICE Breaker
quest_pool.objective: Hack 4 Black ICE protected systems and survive.
quest_pool.description: Black ICE will fry your brain if you're not careful. But the paydata behind it? Worth the risk. Show me you can dance with death.

quest_pool.title: Derelict Data Mining
quest_pool.objective: Hack 5 systems in Scavenger's Reach.
quest_pool.description: Those wrecks in the Reach? Still got active systems. Ancient data, forgotten secrets. Crack five of them and see what the past was hiding.

quest_pool.title: Gang War Intel
quest_pool.objective: Hack 6 gang terminals to gather intelligence.
quest_pool.description: The gangs are planning something. Crack their terminals, grab their comms. Knowledge is power, and I want ALL the power.

quest_pool.title: Master of the Net
quest_pool.objective: Successfully complete 15 hacks across any systems.
quest_pool.description: You want to be a legend? Fifteen successful breaches. Anywhere, anything. Prove you're the best netrunner this station has ever seen.
